original_card.acceptance_gate: An exact arbitrary-input identity, source/target frame availability and restoration at the chosen cut, plus the complete channel+correction+idle/hosting bill or an explicit favorable bound. The native channel alone is not a supplier. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

existing_checks.remaining: The next experiment must identify uncovered source-specific work. Successor archive intake does not transfer this admission.

actual_scope: Five general laws that bound P104 helper, owned and credit changes, each with an exact self-contained check: (1) the credit/cut law for credited public fields with its census on all 511 principal up-sets of #7334; (2) SPEC-forced dot-product legality of the chart family; (3) the owned-unit deletion bound C >= 56 - E(p) on E8 punctures; (4) odd-rank classes of per-port 2x2 contracts, the equality clause and the general hub bound; (5) sound and conditional lower bounds on #7334's helper layer.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a constructive helper-basis or causal-split improvement. This package instead states and checks the structural laws that any such change must respect; it makes no kappa claim.
bottleneck_link: Each law prices or forbids a class of changes to the complete P104 invoice: credited public substitutes for owned entries (law 1), alternative legality forms (law 2), owned-unit deletion by puncture (law 3), per-port contract choices (law 4), and how far the helper layer can fall under per-frame rank bounds (law 5).
stop_rule: Every stated number reproduced by a standard-library checker from repository data or vendored, hash-authenticated data, with biting controls; validator PASS.

open_questions.first_step: Define S_G(t) with departures and test whether the time-resolved count beats B_G on #7334's frames.
